{
  "voter": "Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite",
  "round": 13,
  "audit_summary": "The site is technically well-structured for AI ingestion but suffers from significant 'content drift' between the actual product catalog and the AI-facing text files. While the schema is robust, the lack of a comprehensive sitemap and the omission of newer products in llms.txt create a 'trust gap' that prevents AI models from fully indexing the breadth of the JARA catalog.",
  "findings": [
    {
      "id": "F1",
      "dimension": "llm_surface",
      "severity": "critical",
      "title": "llms.txt catalog mismatch",
      "evidence": "§4.8 shows 6 products listed; §4.3 confirms 9 products exist.",
      "issue": "AI crawlers receive an incomplete inventory list, causing hallucinations or omission of valid products in search answers.",
      "fix": "Update public/llms.txt to include: deck-modular, lap-siding-tongue-and-groove, and corrugated-roof-tile.",
      "expected_impact": "Ensures AI models have a complete, accurate map of the JARA catalog for B2B procurement queries.",
      "ship_blocker_impact": null
    },
    {
      "id": "F2",
      "dimension": "schema_density",
      "severity": "high",
      "title": "Missing sitemap entries for product pages",
      "evidence": "§4.10 confirms sitemap.xml only contains the homepage.",
      "issue": "Search engines and AI crawlers struggle to discover deep-linked product pages without a complete sitemap.",
      "fix": "Implement app/sitemap.ts to dynamically generate URLs for all 9 product slugs, /resources, and /service-areas.",
      "expected_impact": "Increases crawl frequency and index coverage for specific product-intent queries.",
      "ship_blocker_impact": null
    },
    {
      "id": "F3",
      "dimension": "trust_signals",
      "severity": "medium",
      "title": "Empty sameAs and social entity signals",
      "evidence": "§4.7 shows social object is empty; §4.6 confirms no sameAs in Organization schema.",
      "issue": "AI models lack external verification signals to confirm the entity's authority in the US construction market.",
      "fix": "Populate lib/site.ts with verified LinkedIn/industry profile URLs and add them to the organizationSchema() in lib/jsonld.ts.",
      "expected_impact": "Boosts entity confidence scores in AI knowledge graphs, increasing citation probability.",
      "ship_blocker_impact": null
    },
    {
      "id": "F4",
      "dimension": "title_description",
      "severity": "medium",
      "title": "Spanish title brand-bookending",
      "evidence": "§4.2 shows /es title is 113 chars and repeats brand name.",
      "issue": "The title is too long for optimal AI snippet selection and suffers from keyword dilution due to redundant branding.",
      "fix": "Shorten /es title to: 'PLYCEM Entrepiso Alto Desempeño | JARA International Inc.'",
      "expected_impact": "Improves click-through rate and snippet clarity for Spanish-speaking construction labor queries.",
      "ship_blocker_impact": null
    }
  ],
  "external_claim_adjudication": [
    { "id": "G1", "verdict": "CONFIRM", "evidence": "§4.7 tagline and §4.8 description align with this positioning." },
    { "id": "G2", "verdict": "REFUTE", "evidence": "Site provides specific technical compliance data (UL R15140, ASTM E-136) far beyond generic brochures." },
    { "id": "G3", "verdict": "PARTIAL", "evidence": "Organization schema exists (§4.6); Service schema is currently handled via areaServed array." },
    { "id": "G4", "verdict": "PARTIAL", "evidence": "While 60 chars is standard for SERP, AI overviews often handle longer titles; however, front-loading is more critical than length." },
    { "id": "G5", "verdict": "CONFIRM", "evidence": "AI extractors perform better with structured data than prose; §4.6 additionalProperty is a good start." },
    { "id": "G6", "verdict": "REFUTE", "evidence": "Violates B2B privacy and proprietary logistics model; JARA is the importer of record." },
    { "id": "G7", "verdict": "CONFIRM", "evidence": "Standard performance optimization, though R12 already addressed infra." },
    { "id": "G8", "verdict": "CONFIRM", "evidence": "High-value for AI citation; currently missing." },
    { "id": "G9", "verdict": "REFUTE", "evidence": "The site is highly technical and specific, not 'generic corporate messaging'." },
    { "id": "G10", "verdict": "CONFIRM", "evidence": "This is the correct strategic path for B2B SEO." }
  ],
  "strengths": [
    "Strict adherence to compliance-heavy schema (UL/ASTM/IAPMO) in JSON-LD.",
    "Use of /api/llm-context provides a machine-readable source of truth.",
    "Clear separation of concerns between US-based entity and Costa Rican manufacturing.",
    "Effective use of MadeToOrder availability schema to manage expectations."
  ],
  "open_questions": [
    "Does the current /api/llm-context return the full 9-product catalog, or is it also missing the 3 products missing from llms.txt?",
    "Are the compliance certs in additionalProperty being correctly parsed by Google's Product rich result tool as distinct entities?"
  ]
}
